configurePresets.name: win64-base
configurePresets.description: Shared toolchain for every win64 preset: Visual Studio generator, x64 host and target. RelWithDebInfo is the default configuration, picked by the build presets.

configurePresets.name: win64-vendored-ruby
configurePresets.description: Compiles the vendored CRuby in third_party/ruby; the interpreter is never taken from outside the tree.

configurePresets.name: emscripten-wasm32
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles the engine for wasm32 with the Emscripten SDK. The SDK is found by cmake/emscripten.toolchain.cmake ($EMSDK, or $EMSCRIPTEN), so nothing machine specific is recorded here: source emsdk_env (or export EMSDK) first. Ninja is needed as well. Set URGE_WEB_ASSETS to a game directory: it is published beside the module as assets/ and indexed by app/build_mapping.py, so the game loads its resources on demand instead of the page waiting for all of them.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64
configurePresets.description: Cross-compiles the engine for Android (URGE_RUNNER_MODEL defaults to poll here: the engine owns the loop, which also keeps ART happy about the stack). The NDK is found by cmake/android.toolchain.cmake ($ANDROID_NDK_HOME, or the SDK's ndk/ directory), so nothing machine specific is recorded here. Game becomes libmain.so and is copied into android/app/src/main/jniLibs/arm64-v8a after the build, where the Gradle project packages it; the game's own files are read out of the APK's assets/ at first launch. Needs the aarch64-linux-android Rust target for wgpu-native. API 28 is the floor, and the APK's minSdk matches it.

configurePresets.name: android-x86_64
configurePresets.description: The same build for x86_64 emulator images, which is what a machine without an arm64 device has to test on. Output goes to android/app/src/main/jniLibs/x86_64 and is packaged into the same APK as the arm64 build, so one APK runs on both. Needs the x86_64-linux-android Rust target for wgpu-native.
